title: Red Envelope Reforge
description: This is a mod that allows you to send red envelopes.
body:
Mirgate from [Red Envelope](https://modrinth.com/mod/red-envelope).
----
This is a mod that allows you to send red envelopes.

Use `/hongbao common [count] [single]` to send a regular red envelope.

![common](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/885d637c9cff9b1a3d5a756a306ec27e76b39a4f.png)

Use `/hongbao luck [count] [itemcount]` to send a lucky red envelope.

![luck](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5819aee8236f2c1773039b291113417a856107b9.png)

Use `/hongbao spell [count] [words]` to send a password red envelope.

![spell](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/766d238305c68c773b6c6d6571eca4451b0c0763.png)

Use `/hongbao query` to query red envelopes.

![query](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c92fa952efaed6076dfb93b98d00ca7af308e2b3.png)

Unlike the original mod, this mod has made some slight adjustments: 

- Added sound effects for sending, receiving, and reclaiming red envelopes;

- In terms of commands, the maximum number of red envelopes that can be sent and the maximum number of items is limited to 64;

- Fixed the issue in the original mod where the 'all' parameter after the 'query' command could not properly display the status of all red envelopes that had already been sent;

- When sending 'lucky draw' red envelopes and password red envelopes, if the number sent exceeds the actual number of items, there is a chance to receive an empty red envelope (although this is really unethical);

- Added cooldown and daily maximum sending limits for red envelopes, which can be customized in the redenvelope-common.toml configuration file;

- Players can use `/hongbao query cooldown` to check the remaining red envelope cooldown time, and `/hongbao query remain` to check the number of red envelopes that can be sent today.
